page_title: Itsyhome – Smart home control for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV

sources.entry: Itsyhome - Control your HomeKit and Home Assistant smart home from the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/nickustinov/itsyhome-macos) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/itsyhome/id6758070650?platform=mac)

summary.name: Itsyhome
summary.one_liner: A native smart home controller for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV that controls HomeKit devices on all platforms and Home Assistant on Mac.
use_cases: Control lights, locks, and thermostats from an iPhone or iPad
Manage HomeKit and Home Assistant devices from the Mac menu bar
View live security camera feeds and doorbell rings
Control smart home devices from Apple TV
Run a local smart home controller without a third-party cloud
summary.what_it_does: Itsyhome is a native controller for Apple HomeKit accessories on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV, with a standalone Apple Watch app. On Mac it lives in the menu bar and also connects directly to a Home Assistant server over WebSocket and REST using a long-lived access token. It supports a wide range of device types, including lights, fans, thermostats, blinds, locks, garage doors, security systems, cameras, doorbells, and various sensors. Cameras stream live with zoom and on-screen controls, can be arranged in a customisable mosaic, and doorbell rings open the camera view automatically. HomeKit control runs through Apple's framework and Home Assistant connects to the user's own server, with iCloud sync via CloudKit.
notable: Home Assistant support on Mac, connecting directly to the user's server with no intermediary cloud
Home Assistant cameras stream over WebRTC for low-latency video
One-time Pro unlock shared across platforms with Family Sharing support
caveats: Cameras and advanced features require the one-time $12.99 Pro unlock on Mac
iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV offer a 3-day free trial before the Pro unlock is required
Home Assistant support is available on Mac only
